Name: Abigail Lewd Dialogue

Description:
Abigail, bored with her county living, has decided that the way of the cam-girl was for her.  She is now uninhibited and freely talks about sex and her desires.  Events, friendship, and marriage dialogue has undergone these adjustments.
This new dialogue is written in a way that is very implicit.  She very rarely bluntly states exactly what she means, but you can figure it out.
